teams.heading: Fiji fall to bottom of tournament table following three successive defeats
teams.body: Fiji sit bottom of the tournament table following three consecutive defeats. The team have struggled for form, scoring just 49 points in their three matches. Defensively, they have leaked 145 points over the same period. Their latest setback was a 17-33 loss against Scotland in the third round. This run of form is a far cry from 2023, when the side reached their highest ever world ranking of No. 7.

teams.heading: Sam Underhill undergoes bicep surgery to miss England's Nations Championship campaign
teams.body: England flanker Sam Underhill will miss November's Nations Championship Tests after Bath confirmed he requires surgery on a ruptured bicep. The 30-year-old was forced off 48 minutes into his comeback appearance against Harlequins last Friday. Bath head of rugby Johann van Graan confirmed the diagnosis, stating Underhill will undergo surgery on Thursday and face "a few months" on the sidelines. It is a major blow for Steve Borthwick's side, especially after Underhill missed the July tour with a shoulder issue.

lead.why: Sam Underhill has been ruled out of England's November campaign after sustaining a bicep rupture that requires surgery.

teams.heading: Yann Roubert backs proposal to reduce Champions Cup to 16 teams
teams.body: Yann Roubert has endorsed a proposed overhaul of the Investec Champions Cup, supporting a reduction from 24 teams to 16. The plan, reportedly driven by English clubs, would see the French Top 14 provide five or six representatives in a bid to prioritise "very high-level matches." Roubert also noted that the long-term participation of South African sides remains a point for discussion, acknowledging that no South African club has yet progressed beyond the quarter-final stage of the tournament.

teams.heading: Casey and Loughman return for Munster as Leinster lose Deegan to concussion
teams.body: Munster have been bolstered by the return of Ireland internationals Craig Casey and Jeremy Loughman ahead of their weekend clash with the Bulls. The pair are back in contention following their mandatory IRFU rest period after the July tour. Conversely, Leinster coach Leo Cullen will be without fly-half Harry Byrne and back-rower Max Deegan for the Sharks match due to concussion. They join a lengthy injury list that includes Caelan Doris and Jamison Gibson-Park as the province prepares for its trip to Durban.

teams.heading: Uruguayan flanker Lucas Bianchi completes move to Italian side Viadana
teams.body: Uruguay international Lucas Bianchi has secured a move to Serie A Elite side Viadana. The 25-year-old flanker, who represented Los Teros at the 2023 Rugby World Cup, arrives with 29 test caps of experience. Having previously featured for Peñarol and captained the Uruguay XV, Bianchi is one of several South American players seeking professional contracts in Europe as the build-up to the 2027 Rugby World Cup intensifies. His arrival bolsters the domestic competition ahead of the new season.

lead.why: The recruitment of experienced international talent is a material development for the Italian rugby landscape.

teams.heading: Craig Dods departs Scottish Rugby to lead Canada sevens programme
teams.body: Galashiels-born Craig Dods has been appointed as the new head coach of Canada’s men’s sevens team. Dods, who previously served as a specialist skills coach with Scottish Rugby and as an assistant coach for the British sevens setup, will also act as an assistant to head coach Stephen Meehan for the Canadian 15s squad. He takes on the role with the aim of guiding the men’s sevens programme toward qualification for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympic Games.

teams.heading: Welsh Stars Thrive In England As Premier League Impact Intensifies
teams.body: The opening weekend of the PREM Rugby season saw a significant Welsh influence, with several high-profile exports making immediate impressions across the league. Gloucester captain Dewi Lake marked his debut with two tries and a player-of-the-match award, while Aaron Wainwright delivered a standout performance for Leicester Tigers. Saracens scrum-half Tomos Williams also earned acclaim, with head coach Joe Shaw noting, "Considering he's just come to a new team and had to learn everything very quickly, it just shows what his class is."

teams.heading: Argentina to face Australia in Sydney and Townsville during 2027
teams.body: Argentina will play two matches against Australia in July 2027 as part of the Rugby Championship. The fixtures are confirmed for the opening two rounds, with venues scheduled for Sydney and Townsville. This tournament structure will serve as the final preparation for international sides ahead of the Rugby World Cup later that year. Argentina currently hold a record of P3 W1 D0 L2, having most recently suffered a 24-31 defeat to England in Round 3.

teams.heading: Australia and South Africa confirm landmark 100th Test match meeting
teams.body: Rugby Australia has confirmed the international calendar for 2027, which includes a historic 100th Test match against the Springboks. The rivalry, dating back to 1933, will be renewed twice during the year, with the second encounter set to mark the centenary milestone. This announcement follows the Wallabies' recent 42-38 victory over the world champions in Perth, a match that saw the hosts hold off a late comeback despite being reduced to 11 men during a chaotic final quarter.

lead.why: This is a significant, verified announcement regarding the future of the Wallabies-Springboks rivalry.

teams.heading: Japan Women’s XV Display Fighting Spirit Despite Narrow Loss To Ireland
teams.body: The Japan Women’s XV demonstrated resilience in their 24-31 defeat to Ireland in the WXV Global Series at Dexcom Stadium. After conceding an early 19-0 lead, the Sakura XV utilised their rolling maul effectively, with Moe Nagaoka crossing for two tries. Head coach Toshizumi Kitagawa noted, "We didn't get the result we wanted as this is a Test match and winning is the ultimate goal." Despite the loss, Japan’s improved second-half linespeed and physicality highlighted their ability to compete against higher-ranked opposition.

teams.heading: Codie Taylor captains All Blacks squad as Scott Barrett returns home
teams.body: Dave Rennie has named a 34-man squad for the Bledisloe Cup, entrusting hooker Codie Taylor with the captaincy following Ardie Savea’s season-ending shoulder injury. The selection features the return of experienced lock Scott Barrett, who has recovered from back surgery, and loose forward Shannon Frizell, back from Japan. While the squad welcomes senior reinforcements, fly-half Ruben Love is unavailable due to an ankle ligament injury. Rennie noted, "Codie is a top man who has huge mana. His leadership as tour captain was important."

teams.heading: Paul de Villiers vows Springboks will return fighting after Perth defeat
teams.body: Flanker Paul de Villiers has promised a robust response from the world champions when their Nations Championship campaign resumes in November. Following the 42-38 loss to the Wallabies in Perth, the 23-year-old admitted the match highlighted the value of learning through adversity. "We’re not done," De Villiers said. "There are still a couple of games coming up in November, and for the Nations Championship we’re going to go all in and make sure we do everything we can to win that trophy."

lead.why: It focuses on the squad's direct response to their recent defeat and their forward-looking commitment to the upcoming Nations Championship.
